core.why: Current documentation for any library or framework, so code isn't written from stale memory.
Drives a real browser: end-to-end tests, UI checks, screenshots, reproducing bugs.
Systematic debugging, test-driven development, brainstorming and plan-then-execute workflows.
Multi-agent review of a pull request or diff for real bugs.
Security review of generated code: pattern warnings on edits and a diff review before finishing.

extras.why: Database, auth, storage and advisors for BakeFlow and ShiftOS. Needs a Supabase login. Keep agent access read-only on production.
Repos, issues and pull requests from inside Claude.
Production error monitoring: read reports and stack traces, debug live failures.
Product analytics, feature flags and error tracking; shows what users actually do, which feeds marketing and strategy.
Live Chrome debugging: performance traces, network requests, console errors.
Free static security scanning while code is written.
Deep vulnerability scan of your own code with every finding challenged. Run before releases; it uses a lot of tokens.
TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence (definitions, references, types).
